newsitem.title: USA: LOUISVILLE FEEDER CATTLE MARKET STEADY - USDA.
newsitem.headline: LOUISVILLE FEEDER CATTLE MARKET STEADY - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were steady, compared with Monday's close, USDA said. Cattle and Calves Receipts - 1,000
Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 600- 700 lbs 74.00-78.50; 800-900 lbs 66.50-73.00. Medium and Large 2 500-600 lbs few 81.25. Holstein Large 2 600-700 lbs 57.25-62.00; 700-800 lbs 58.25-64.40.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 500-600 lbs 73.25, some blacks 81.00-83.00. Medium and Large 2 500-600 lbs 68.00-69.00.
